ABOUT THIS LANDSCAPE

A real place.
A living interpretation.

A roughly 7 × 7 km patch around Lake Inari, Finland. Ground elevations come from a downloaded Mapzen / Tilezen Terrarium tile, hosted by AWS Open Data. The elevation range and your position are calculated from that data.

Trees are procedurally placed, and lake water is approximated with a constant elevation surface. This is a landscape visualization, not a surveyed forest or a navigation map. Relief starts at 2×; select 1× for the original elevation scale.

Europe terrain: produced using Copernicus data and information funded by the European Union — EU-DEM layers. ArcticDEM data were created from DigitalGlobe imagery and funded under NSF awards 1043681, 1559691 and 1542736. Global GMTED2010/SRTM courtesy of USGS.

Elevation dataset · Full source attribution · Explore the real Inari

Rendered with Three.js r186. Instanced woodland, animated water, atmospheric fog, physically based materials and filmic tone mapping.
